title: Fourier weight above a degree threshold
statement: For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and an integer $k\ge 0$, define its Fourier weight above degree $k$ to be the sum of the Fourier weights of all subsets $S\subseteq[n]$ with $|S|>k$.
